description: Synthetic sesslint.adapters.synthetic parity (reserved namespace IDs and collision guard only).
known_parity_gaps: check_event: sesslint.canonical.SessionEvent is not ported; Rust check_event returns CheckEventError without registering an event — no vector.
unicode_nd_digits: Python str.isdigit and default re \d accept Unicode decimal digits (e.g. U+0661); Rust port accepts ASCII 0-9 only — documented gap, not a required vector.
lone_surrogate_source_hint: Python encode(errors='replace') can hash a lone surrogate; Rust str cannot hold one — no vector.
